rationale: Translate the company’s technological level/capability as surpassing competitors, not the competitors themselves.
Mark political/ideological motive as typical, not mandatory; preserve the targeted secret-killing sense without graphic detail.
Make mental calculation the primary gloss; “oral arithmetic” can imply speaking numbers aloud.
Translate 第三者機関 as a third-party/outside organization, not necessarily independent.
Preserve the mutual reaffirmation in 確認し合った.
Distinguish 異動 and 移動 as separate homophones, not alternate spellings.
Translate 一段落 as a stage/phase completed, not the whole undertaking.
Remove tautology in 一連なり and simplify the procedural-sequence translation.
Replace the unnatural “вклав усю старанність” with “виготовив із великою ретельністю”.
Use 人を援助する for the direct object and 人に援助を行う for the recipient marked by に.
